new_claims.statement: For any two literal physical coordinates H={a,b}, define V=sum_i sum_{T subset H^c\{i}, |T|=3} det A[H union {i},T]^2. If V>0, then every independent cap-one product law gives a continuous density with ||p_Q||inf <=5.35(256/27)^(1/6)V^(-1/6)<7.784V^(-1/6), and the same coefficient times interval length. The physical pair core and arbitrary leaf curvature are unrestricted.

For a literal leaf partition I,J, Delta_J=det(A[H,J]A[H,J]^T), Pi_J projection onto row(A[H,J]), and c_i=A[i,J](I-Pi_J), one has Delta_J||c_i||^2=sum_{T subset J,|T|=3} det A[H union {i},T]^2. Consequently E W=(1-p)p^3V under Bernoulli partition.

The r35 fixed pair has V>=27G_*/400; therefore the new aggregate theorem gives a continuous density bound <12.198G_*^(-1/6) uniformly across all physical pair core strata and arbitrary leaf curvature.
